# Challenge 002: Subscription price-change email

This challenge asks `content.md` to replace a vague subscription email with a
standalone explanation of the current price, new price, renewal date,
cancellation deadline, and effect of cancellation.

The frozen input is `scenario.json`. The exact repository-agent candidate and
deterministic diagnosis are under `outputs/contentmd/`. Claude and Cursor each
receive a separate digest-bound packet and must not inspect the other review.

This challenge is synthetic, English-only, and unreviewed. It is not approved
product content or benchmark gold.
